summary: Learn AI fairness testing, robustness checks, model risk assessment, and audit documentation. Explore the practical five-day course.
lede: AI assurance training helps auditors, model risk managers, compliance officers, and AI product owners evaluate controls and document evidence. Participants practise mapping AI inventories and risk boundaries, interpreting fairness and robustness tests, and recording model changes and monitoring plans. Using the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 as reference points, they build traceable assurance records and prioritized action plans for operational AI systems.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who evaluate, govern, build, or oversee AI systems and need defensible evidence of controls, testing, and monitoring.
modules: AI Assurance Reporting and Action Plans
prerequisites: Prior familiarity with AI system lifecycles, model development or deployment, or risk and control processes is recommended. Coding is not required for course completion; technical test methods are addressed through guided examples and interpretation of results.
